A caravan with a repopulation specialist can hand over pawns to other faction's settlement. The intended design is to hand over children that can walk, but some people prefer to also be able to offload babies fresh from the oven.
Prevent deletion of fathers relevant to Repopulationism (Necessary if using Repopulationism)

This setting is important for Repopulationism to work properly. The aggressive culling of World-Pawns of 1.6 sometimes deletes fathers before children are born and before they can come to pick up their children.
Prevent deletion of children of colonists
What is the point of Repopulationism if your children instantly get autodeleted by Rimworlds overly aggressive Garbage Collection?

Attempt to prevent deletion of those selected above by other mods suchs as BetterGC (Dangerous / Needs restart)

Do not turn this on unless needed. Some WorldPawn cleaning mods skip the vanilla validiation of WorldPawns and straight up go to deletion, yet still use the vanilla method to delete them. Enabling this setting will patch that vanilla method in hopes of preserving your friends. Personally I'd recommend disabling those other mods, as vanilla Rimworld 1.6 is already aggressive enough on its own when purging WorldPawns. Toggling needs a restart to take effact.
